execution_authorization: User explicitly requested audit, labels, comparison cases, chronological TabPFN training and MLflow results
population: All 1746 RITHMIC STOP/ICEBERG archived notifications: ES229 NQ907 GC208 CL402. Every event retains an audit and label status.
unit: First notification of a same-contract connected episode whose decision-5m to decision+15m windows overlap. Never substitute a later valid head after outcomes.
known_at: max Discord sent and edited timestamp; decision 30 seconds later. Detection and actual receiver times unknown.
quotes: Original locally catalogued exact individual-contract TBBO quotes, hashes checked against import reports. Availability=max(ts_event,ts_init). No paid download, front-month substitution or missing-row imputation.
feature_validity: Last raw quote strictly before decision, including invalid snapshot rejection, <=5 seconds old. 5min context on one-second grid >=80% valid/fresh and no missing run >30s. Anchors at -60/-300s fresh <=5s. RV=sqrt(sum squared valid adjacent 1s mid changes), floor one tick.
session: CME trading-day starts 17:00 Chicago, ends16:00, exclude daily halt and crossing; missing holiday paths fail freshness. This is not a complete holiday schedule assertion.
extra_SI_features: arrow times distance from zone center / RV
primary_target: Three classes FLAT0 LONG1 SHORT2. Hypothetical one-mini entry at first valid quote at/after decision <=5s, exit at first valid quote at/after entry+15min <=5s. Long uses entry ask/exit bid, short entry bid/exit ask. Class profitable side after frozen NinjaTrader-free per-side commissions; otherwise FLAT. No label if path validity <80% or missing run >30s.
fees_source: outputs/SI-Nautilus-Ereignistest-v1/summarize.py FEES.ninjatrader_free, existing frozen research profile, not a current broker tariff claim
secondary: 5min same target (descriptive only, no second fit); adverse extra one tick each side on 15min quote markouts. No SI event is itself a strategy entry.
controls: Outcome-blind 1:1 price-context matching without reuse; same contract, same CME day, same 30min Chicago bucket. Minute grid between first and last archived same-day notifications; exclude +/-1230s around any archived same-contract feed notification. Bracketing is an archive condition, NOT proof of feed uptime or true event absence. Fixed calipers: move60/300 in RV .5 each, logRV .5, spread1tick, imbalance.5, age2s. Match by sum squared caliper-scaled differences. Freeze matching and context hashes before computing labels. Unmatched heads retained in main paired ablation.
validation: Chronological whole CME dates across all markets. First40 observed catalog trading dates initial train, one whole-day gap, successive10-date tests, expanding training capped1000 rows by dropping oldest whole days. Purge overlapping information/outcome intervals across boundary. Min50 train rows, >=2 classes. Both arms identical IDs/labels/folds; missing-class probabilities aligned to three classes.
model: Pinned official local TabPFN v2 classifier; 4 estimators CPU seed20261121; no hyperparameter/feature/threshold search. Current-row singleton predictions. Price market code categorical; SI type and arrow categorical. No controls mixed into training as fake negatives.
primary_metric: Paired mean logloss(price) minus logloss(price+SI), positive favors SI. Common later episodes only; train-only class-prior benchmark. 1999 moving five-trading-day block bootstrap draws, seed20261121; >=20 testdays required for inferential interpretation. CI conditional on fitted development models, not proof of fresh-market generalization.
secondary_metrics: Multiclass Brier, balanced accuracy, macro market losses; fixed argmax hypothetical quote markout per forecast normal/stress, not an orderfill, portfolio, provider payout or equity curve.
verification: Native Nautilus Price/Quantity decoding checks, future-truncation feature parity and deliberately leaky sentinel, identical arm folds and IDs, byte-hash data manifests. Public repo excludes raw quotes, event rows/private IDs and model weights.
limits: Repeatedly studied May-Oct2026 development material. Chronological is not untouched OOS. TBBO samples BBO at trades; freshness failures do not prove data outages. Direction label is a fixed markout proxy, no claim of SI causality or trading improvement. Existing strategies and simulations unchanged. Built with PriorLabs-TabPFN.
